document_metadata.document_title: Stormwater Management Regulations, Standards, Procedures and Design Criteria Manual

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Must meet SFWMD criteria for dry pre-treatment retention/detention plus District water quality and quantity requirements. Discharge limited by basin (e.g., inches of runoff per day per acre for SFWMD C-9 / C-11 basins). Structures protected against 100-year, 3-day storm; second-order drainage systems designed for 3-year rainfall (FDOT Zone 10).
peak_flow_calculation_method: 3-year design for second-order / internal drainage (FDOT Zone 10 IDF)
Allowable discharge rates by SFWMD basin (C-9 / C-11)

evidence.excerpt: SOUTH BROWARD DRAINAGE DISTRICT / BROWARD COUNTY, FLORIDA
STORMWATER MANAGEMENT REGULATIONS, STANDARDS, PROCEDURES AND DESIGN CRITERIA MANUAL
supplement the established rules ... South Florida Water Management District (SFWMD)
meet SFWMD criteria for dry, pre-treatment retention/detention
allowable discharge ... inch of runoff per day per acre ... SFWMD C-9 / C-11 basin
The minimum longitudinal slope for roadways and roadway swales shall be 0.3% or 0.003 feet per foot.
Swale means a man-made trench that: (a) Has a top width-to-depth ratio of the cross-section equal to or greater than 6:1...
Exfiltration Trench means an underground drainage system that has the capacity to store and percolate stormwater runoff into the ground water.
Detention means a system designed to store and retain stormwater with controlled discharge to a lake or receiving body of water.
Semi-impervious means land surfaces that partially restrict the penetration of water; such as porous concrete and asphalt pavements, gravel, limerock, and certain compacted soils.

extraction_quality.review_notes: SBDD criteria cover southern Broward; Central Broward WCD has separate manual. Pipeline excerpt repair removed 1 unlocated citation(s).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: SBDD defers soil storage and water-quality computations to SFWMD Environmental Resource Permit Applicant's Handbook; excerpt cites percolation/K-factor for exfiltration trenches but no numeric in/hr design rate. Dry detention/retention and swale inverts must be at least 1 ft above basin control elevation (CWE), not stated as seasonal high water table separation. Level of service: 10-year 3-day for roads/parking; 100-year 3-day for building finished floors.
